description: Fix cookie configuration issues for cross-domain deployment - logout uses hardcoded SameSite=Lax that doesn't match login cookie settings
steps: Fix logoutController in backend/src/modules/student/student.controller.js - replace res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', ...) with res.clearCookie() using same settings as verification controller

Ensure cookie settings match between login (/api/verification/verify) and logout (/api/student/logout): sameSite: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'none' : 'lax', secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
acceptance_criteria: Login and logout use identical cookie configuration
Cookies work correctly in production cross-domain environment (frontend and backend on different Vercel domains)
verification: Test logout endpoint clears cookie with correct headers
Verify production cookie settings: sameSite='none', secure=true when NODE_ENV=production
Test cross-domain cookie behavior in development (sameSite='lax')
